newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 30 bln levs 3-yr T-notes at par.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 30 bln levs 3-yr T-notes at par.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry issue of 35 billion levs of three-year, floating interest T-notes was 86 percent sold at par value at Friday's auction, yielding 77.46 percent, central bank figures showed.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance.
Interest on the paper was set at four percentage points over the central bank annual main interest rate for the period to maturity and would be adjusted each time the main rate changes.
The effective annual yield was calculated under the new, lower main interest rate of 62.4 percent annually, a central bank official told Reuters.
The central bank on Thursday cut its main rate from 74.4 percent annually to 62.4 percent annually, to go in force from Monday, May 12.
Coupon payments are due semi-annually until maturity. Principal is due at maturity together with the last coupon payment.
